newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - NatWest sees higher Danish '97 GDP growth.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - NatWest sees higher Danish '97 GDP growth.

text.p: In its latest survey Britain's NatWest Markets on Monday raised its expectations for Denmark's 1997 GDP (gross domestic product) growth to 3.0 percent from 2.9 percent in its last forecast in January.
Otherwise NatWest left it its forecast for the 1997 current account surplus at an unchanged 8.3 billion crown and kept its inflation forecast for this year at 2.6 percent.

The latest Danish Economy Ministry forecast in December foresaw 2.9 percent GDP growth, 2.3 percent inflation, 8.0 percent unemployment and a current account surplus of 13.0 billion crowns for this year.
The following estimates were made by 10 leading local and international organisations.
